entries.title: Psalms 55:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David in his prayer complains of his fearful case. 9 He prays against his enemies, of whose wickedness and treachery he complains. 16 He comforts himself in God's preservation of him, and confusion of his enemies.

A.M. 2983. B.C. 1021. (Title.) Neginoth. 6:1; 54:1; *titles Give. 5:1; 17:1; 64:1; 80:1; 84:8; 1Pe 3:12 hide. 28:1; 80:4; 143:7; La 3:8

entries.title: Psalms 55:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Fearfulness. 119:120; 2Sa 15:14; Job 6:4; 23:15,16 horror. 42:6; 61:2; 88:15,16; Lu 22:44 overwhelmed. Heb. covered.

entries.title: Psalms 55:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
the windy storm.From the sweeping wind and tempest,--Absalom and his rebellious party.

18:4; Isa 17:12,13; Mt 7:25-27

entries.title: Psalms 55:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
divide.That is, "Distract their counsels; and let their devices be confounded;"--and the prayer was heard; See the Parallel Passages.

Ge 11:7-9; 2Sa 15:31; 17:1-14; Joh 7:45-53; Ac 23:6-10 I have. Jer 6:7; 23:14; Mt 23:37,38

entries.title: Psalms 55:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a man mine equal. Heb. a man according to my rank. myguide. 2Sa 15:12; 16:23; Jer 9:4; Mic 7:5 mine acquaintance. Joh 19:13; Mt 26:47-50; Mr 14:44,45; Lu 22:21,47,48

entries.title: Psalms 55:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: We took sweet counsel together. Heb. Who sweetened counsel.walked. 42:4; 122:1; Isa 2:3; Eze 33:31

entries.title: Psalms 55:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Let death, etc.Or, rather, "Death shall seize on them; they shall descend quickly into the grave;" which is a prediction of the sudden destruction which befell the ringleaders of this unnatural rebellion.

59:13; 69:22-28; 109:6-20; 2Sa 17:23; 18:9,14; Mt 27:5; Ac 1:18-20 them. Nu 16:30-34; Mt 26:24; Ac 1:25 hell. or, the grave. 9:17

entries.title: Psalms 55:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: hear. 65:5; 143:12; 1Th 2:15,16; Re 6:10,11 even. 90:1,2; De 33:27; Mic 5:2; Col 1:17 Because, etc. or, With whom also there be no changes, yetthey fear not God. no changes. 73:5,6; Pr 1:32; Ec 8:11; Isa 36:20; Jer 48:11; Zep 1:12

entries.title: Psalms 55:23
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: O God. 7:15,16; 58:9; 59:12,13 pit. Pr 15:11; 27:20; Isa 38:17 bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days.Heb. men of bloods and deceit shall not halve their days. 5:6; 2Sa 3:27; 20:9,10; 1Ki 2:5,6; 2Sa 3:27; 20:9,10; 1Ki 2:5,6 Job 15:32; Pr 10:27; Ec 7:17; Mt 27:4,5
